from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action stated in the document (e.g., '继承纠纷', '行政诉讼')")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of legal document (e.g., '民事判决书', '民事裁定书')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
